summary: A resident asks what council members will say to merchants who already collect deposits without a waiver.
realLife: Charles Atkins argued that a waiver for annexed property would treat existing city merchants unfairly and set a precedent.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: existing and proposed outlet obligations.

turns.what: An existing merchant asks whether their own address qualifies.
turns.writesBack: The clerk explains the qualifying circumstances to an existing shop.

turns.what: The new retailer asks when a distributor can deliver marked stock.
turns.writesBack: The newly annexed retailer takes on the same duty as other city shops.
